V2TrendPullback.state: EMA50>EMA200, EMA50 12h slope>=0.3%, efficiency48>=0.25, NATR<=1.5x prior72h mean
V2TrendPullback.setup: Within prior 4 candles low touched EMA20 zone, stayed >=98% EMA50, and close retained >=99.5% EMA50
V2TrendPullback.trigger: Bullish candle close above prior3h high, positive 3h return, close location>=60%
V2TrendPullback.risk: Entry-to-prior6h-low distance 0.35-2.5 ATR; structural damage exit; emergency stop -6%
V2TrendPullback.exit: Close below EMA50 or prior10h low; ROI 6%
V2TrendPullback.rationale: Require established directional state, a controlled retracement, and observable resumption rather than buying the first breakout.

V2CompressionBreakout.state: EMA50 12h slope>=-0.3% and NATR<=1.8x prior72h mean
V2CompressionBreakout.setup: At least 4 of previous6 candles compressed; BB20 width/(4 ATR14)<=0.80 and NATR below prior72h mean
V2CompressionBreakout.trigger: Close above prior12h compression high+0.05ATR, true range>=1.2x prior ATR, relative volume>=1.15, close location>=75%
V2CompressionBreakout.exit: Close below EMA20 or prior12h low; ROI 6%
V2CompressionBreakout.rationale: Demand persistent contraction before participation-backed range expansion and reject structurally wide entries.

V2RegimeAdaptive.state: Exclusive trend state (EMA50>EMA200, slope>=0.25%, efficiency48>=0.25) else range state (abs slope<0.4%, efficiency24<0.30, NATR<1.2x prior72h mean)
V2RegimeAdaptive.setup: Trend: prior4h EMA20 pullback above 98% EMA50. Range: prior close below EMA20-1.35ATR with prior RSI<32
V2RegimeAdaptive.trigger: Trend: bullish prior3h-high reclaim. Range: bullish reversal above prior close. Trend owns overlaps, so one candle cannot use both setups
V2RegimeAdaptive.risk: Trend distance to prior6h low 0.35-2.5 ATR; range candle recovery <=1.5ATR; emergency stop -6%
V2RegimeAdaptive.exit: Close below prior10h low or completed mean reversion (close>=EMA20 and RSI>=50); ROI 6%
V2RegimeAdaptive.rationale: Assign exactly one setup to each of two economic states instead of applying one signal across incompatible conditions.

continuation.profitable_years: at least 3/4, or one near-flat and three clearly positive

operational_definitions.variant_stability: both nearby variants aggregate net>0, PF>1, and >=2 profitable years
operational_definitions.drawdown_limit: candidate max annual wallet drawdown <=1.25x AlphaBreakout

parameter_policy: One predeclared three-value neighborhood per architecture; no search, ranking, or post-result change.
